name: The Westin Grand Cayman Seven Mile Beach Resort & Spa
positioning: A beachfront resort on 700 feet of Seven Mile Beach, with the island's largest freshwater pool, oceanfront rooms and the Hibiscus Spa
best_for: Beach lovers who want rooms right on Seven Mile Beach
Families looking for daily activities and water sports

facts.text: The pool has a swim-up bar with submerged bar stools.
Beach and pool cabanas are available.
The pool area has two hot tubs.
The Hibiscus Spa's treatments are inspired by the ocean, lush landscapes and the island's natural beauty.
Room design begins with an abstract interpretation of the ocean.
Woto serves chef-prepared sushi, ceviche and poke.
Red Sail Sports offers water-based adventures on site.
Family activities include family game nights and kids' scavenger hunts.
The Westin Workout Fitness Studio is open 24 hours.
Seven Mile Beach water averages 80 degrees Fahrenheit in winter.
The resort is minutes from the airport.

highlights.text: The resort sits on 700 feet of white sand on Seven Mile Beach, among tropical palms and casuarina trees.
The freshwater pool, right next to the beach, is the largest on the island.
Deluxe Ocean Front rooms sit directly on Seven Mile Beach with unobstructed ocean views; ground-level rooms have patios and second-floor rooms have balconies.
The Hibiscus Spa has thirteen treatment rooms, two steam and sauna rooms, a women's whirlpool and Vichy showers.
Activities run from sunrise beach yoga and paddleboard clinics to evening s'mores by the fire.

considerations.text: Some activities may need a 24-hour sign-up or carry an additional fee.
WhataHotel notes the location can be busy during peak seasons.
